description: tools/test-projects/input (WEB_PROJECT=input tools/build.sh web): ?input-script=tests/Input/menu.input.json&quit-after-input runs the menu script from the content (input-recorder-and-input-scripts AC12): it waits for the menu, shoots it, taps #play, waits until it was clicked, shoots again; the page logs the click, the run's done line and exit code 0, in order. A build without the flag logs exit code 2.
